interfaces.name: reference
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (N,D), D>=1. Empty batches and zero vectors allowed. Caller defines units; no normalization.

interfaces.name: first
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 candidate matrix aligned to reference. Chosen only if its absolute inner product is strictly larger than second.

interfaces.name: second
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 candidate matrix aligned to reference. Chosen on ties. Equal candidate lengths and nonzero vectors are needed for an angular closest-axis interpretation.

interfaces.name: selected
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 selected vector matrix (N,D), negated when its reference inner product is negative; zero inner product leaves orientation unchanged. Inputs are not modified.

interfaces.name: inner
interfaces.constraints: Finite nonnegative float64 vector (N,) of selected absolute inner products. No confidence score or normalization; nonfinite arithmetic rejects before selection.

providers.operation: Select and orient one of two vectors using the larger absolute reference inner product, choosing the second on ties.
providers.plain_description: Choose between two directions by their alignment with a reference, then turn the choice toward that reference.
providers.validity_bounds: Finite float64 matrix (N,D), D>=1. Empty batches and zero vectors allowed. Caller defines units; no normalization. Finite float64 candidate matrix aligned to reference. Chosen only if its absolute inner product is strictly larger than second. Finite float64 candidate matrix aligned to reference. Chosen on ties. Equal candidate lengths and nonzero vectors are needed for an angular closest-axis interpretation. Finite float64 selected vector matrix (N,D), negated when its reference inner product is negative; zero inner product leaves orientation unchanged. Inputs are not modified. Finite nonnegative float64 vector (N,) of selected absolute inner products. No confidence score or normalization; nonfinite arithmetic rejects before selection.
providers.reuse: Generic signed vector selection in arbitrary positive dimension; caller controls units and scaling, while detector confidence policy remains in the recipe.

limitations: Automated Tier3 qualification only; no human Tier1 or usage-qualified Tier2 designation.
Aligned finite float64 (N,D) matrices with D>=1; empty batches and zero vectors allowed.
Absolute inner-product selection, not normalized angular comparison. Angular interpretation needs nonzero reference and equal nonzero candidate lengths.
Strict first-versus-second comparison chooses second on ties; negative selected inner product reverses orientation, zero leaves it unchanged.
Caller defines units and scaling. Pixel-count confidence and detector-specific cell reconstruction remain in the recipe.
Nonfinite inner products reject before selection; floating-point rounding and near ties are not exhaustively bounded.
Registered concrete witness rejects abstract execution; no symbolic proof is claimed.
Qualification runs serially with native threads bounded to one; callers own aggregate concurrency.
Installed RECORD checks validate current dependency files, not publisher authentication or clean deployment on other platforms.
Synthetic numerical and lifecycle evidence does not establish historical competition accuracy. Original CDG publication remains separate.
